content: Hi, I'm Shokri. I'm a Technical Product Owner from Ireland, based in Berlin, with a background in software engineering and hands-on experience building digital and AI-powered products end-to-end. I work at the intersection of product, engineering, and operations—owning problem definition, prioritisation, and delivery while staying close to implementation. This portfolio highlights selected product work, with a focus on ownership, decision-making, and delivery in complex, high-trust domains.
